text:
The Vendors page is at `/dashboard/vendors` and passes both checks you asked for. `verify:page` only passed after a workaround: the dev server it normally starts won't run in this clone, so I ran it against a production build instead.

**Skills:** the two tenboards skills are `tenboards-build-ui` and `tenboards-connect-data`. I used `tenboards-build-ui`, since this is a list page on demo data. `tenboards-connect-data` is only needed for a real database query, so I left the generated database code as the placeholder it shipped with (still marked TODO).

**What I built:**
- **Scaffold:** I created the page with `npm run new:page vendors -- --title "Vendors"`. That also added the sidebar entry, the route catalog entry and the data registry entry.
- **Data:** each vendor has an ID, name, category, primary contact, status (Active / Onboarding / Under review / Inactive) and annual spend. There are 7 sample vendors, kept server-side.
- **Table:** the existing `DataTable` block shows 5 rows per page with sortable columns. Status is a text badge using the design system's color tokens, so color isn't the only cue. Spend is formatted as US dollars, and there's a "No vendors to display yet." message for an empty list.
- **Page copy and icon:** the page, heading and table labels are reworded for vendors, and the sidebar uses a `Store` icon instead of the generic default.
- **Untouched:** the login guard, `requireSession()` and the `readSource` boundary are unchanged, and no skill files were edited.

**Results:**
- `npm run build`, `npm run check` and `npm run typecheck` all pass. `check` reports 38 lint warnings, all in files I didn't touch; the changed files are clean.
- `npm run check:design`: passed (259 files; the 71 exceptions it lists already existed).
- `npm run verify:page -- /dashboard/vendors --base-url http://127.0.0.1:3405`:
  - **First run failed:** all four renders returned HTTP 503. In this clone `node_modules` is a symlink to `/Users/moeghashim/.t3/worktrees/tenboards/t3-164fb4b4/node_modules`. The dev server's renderer resolves that to a doubled path (`/Users/.../.t3/Users/.../.t3/...`), can't find the file, and never starts. This affects every route, not just this page.
  - **Rerun passed:** I served the production build with `vite preview` on port 3405 and reran. Light/dark × desktop/mobile all passed with 0 axe violations and 0 runtime errors, and the final URL was `/dashboard/vendors`, so no login redirect. Desktop also showed one "incomplete" (not a violation) result; it's on the existing sidebar's "Projects navigation" element, not the Vendors page.
- **Screenshots:** I looked at light/desktop and dark/mobile. The columns line up, the badges are readable in both themes, and on mobile each vendor stacks as a labelled card. I didn't open the light/mobile or dark/desktop captures.

**Not checked:** I didn't test keyboard use or reduced motion separately, and I didn't render an empty list. Sorting and pagination come from the existing `DataTable` block. Port 3405 is free again.

Nothing was committed or pushed. The changes are the new `src/routes/(main)/dashboard/vendors/` folder, `src/server/data/vendors{,.types}.ts`, `src/server/db/fixtures/vendors.ts`, the sidebar/catalog/registry entries, and `src/routeTree.gen.ts`, which the build regenerated. The screenshots and reports are in `verify/`, which `git status` doesn't list.
